title: Routine maintenance civil work to staff quarters and office building at Noida
summary: E-tender for a three-year contract for routine civil maintenance of staff quarters and the office building of the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships at Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships, Noida

sites.name: DGLL staff quarters and office building, A-13 Sector-24, Noida (U.P.)

scope.item: Routine maintenance civil work to staff quarters and office building

money.notes: Expected estimated cost Rs 16,00,000 for one year, inclusive of GST, while contract period is 3 years. Tender fee and EMD by DD from a nationalized bank in favour of Pay & Accounts Officer, Lighthouses & Lightships, Noida.

eligibility: Enlisted contractor with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, NOIDA authority or other Central/State organizations under appropriate classification
Similar works in last 7 years: three works each >= 40%, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost
Valid registration certificate; contractors who satisfactorily completed works for this department in last 7 years and meet the experience criterion considered eligible
Annual financial turnover not less than 30% of estimated cost
notes: Two-page Section I NIT only; no BOQ. Listing title is the file name 'NIT English AMC Civil works'; the actual work name is 'Routine maintenance civil work to staff quarters and office building at Noida'. Download/bid submission 21.07.2023 11:00 to 31.07.2023 15:00; opening 01.08.2023 16:00.
